readability.rationale: Reviewer: code is small and readable; validation order in reserveEquipment reads as the spec; conflict signalled by an explicit flag, not by message text.

maintainability.rationale: Reviewer confirmed layering per architecture: views never touch the database, booking has no HTTP knowledge. Test helpers shared in e2e/support.

security.rationale: Reviewer checked escaping in text and attribute contexts, Host allowlist, cross-site POST guard, string-only fields, 10kb body cap and parameterized SQL. New error handler hides stack traces (manual check: 413 and 403 plain responses). npm audit clean.

reliability.rationale: Overlap check and insert run in BEGIN IMMEDIATE with rollback on every path. In-process requests serialize on the synchronous driver (edge test: 10 simultaneous requests, 1 saved); reviewer ran 4 separate processes x 300 overlapping calls on one file and exactly 1 was saved. busy_timeout now set before the WAL switch.

scalability.rationale: Overlap lookup uses index reservation(equipment_id, status, start_date, end_date); serialized writes are fine for a local app (ADR-01).

compatibility.rationale: Native date inputs with min=today; server stays authoritative for all rules; works without JavaScript.

findings.summary: busy_timeout was set after journal_mode=WAL, so concurrent first start could fail with SQLITE_BUSY.
findings.resolution: busy_timeout pragma moved first in db.ts.

findings.summary: Redundant sort in the concurrency test; the test exercises in-process serialization, not BEGIN IMMEDIATE across processes.
findings.resolution: Sort removed; cross-process behavior verified by the reviewer with a 4-process scratch run, recorded here.

findings.summary: Express default error handler could show stack traces for body parse errors.
findings.resolution: Added handleError that returns plain messages and logs only 500s.

tradeoffs: No permanent multi-process test: the app runs as one local process; ADR-01 keeps it safe if a second process is ever started. Review was of the code before three small low-severity fixes, which were re-verified.
